editorial.name: Sleeknote
editorial.descriptionZh: Sleeknote 做站内弹窗、表单与游戏化营销活动，主打按访客类型分别出招，并把每次曝光的数据记下来。它按 Automotive、Fashion & Apparel、Health & Beauty、SaaS、E-Commerce 等行业分场景卖。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看它把行业垂直场景铺满导航第二层
editorial.noteZh: 首屏整片米色，左上一枚 NEW 胶囊写 Try our app for Shopify，主标题 Don't just collect emails. Know who they are.，副标题强调 on-brand popups 和 gamified campaigns，下面两颗按钮 Start 14-day trial 与带头像的 Book a call with Laurids，再下是三行带勾小字：No credit card required、Money-back guarantee、Email, chat, and phone support。导航里 Sleeknote in use 与 Learn 两栏列得最满，前者列 Automotive、Fashion & Apparel、Health & Beauty、Furniture & Decor、Travel & Tourism、Media、E-Commerce、Enterprise、SaaS、B2B，后者列 Blog、Marketing Calendar、Video Library、Use Cases。往下标题节依次是 Different visitors, different goals. One toolkit.、Make it look like your brand, not a pOpUp、Know what's working. Stop guessing.，并声称有 1,200+ integrations。

reasons.statement: 首页交付的是 Sleeknote 自己的行业场景分区与资源入口，用户拿走的是首页结构与文案；来自 saaslandingpage.com 的落地页灵感池，故归产品与公司官网。
导航只有 Products / Pricing / Company / Learn 与 Log in、Start for free，是产品对外门面。
